records.departmentName: School of Environmental and Forest Sciences (SEFS)
records.text: SEFS 520 Geographic Information Systems in Forest Resources (5) Applications of GIS technology to forest science and management. Fundamentals of GIS systems: data sources, preprocessing, map analysis, output; remote sensing as a source of GIS data, image analysis, and classification. Emphasis on GIS as a source of management and technical information requests. Course overlaps with: URBDP 504. Offered: AWSp.
